question: What function does the enzyme glycogenin exert on the metabolism of the gucógeno ?:

options.opa: Phosphorylates the enzyme glycogen phosphorylase, activating it.
options.opb: It is a primer of glycogen synthase so that it can act in the polymerization of glucose molecules.
options.opc: It is the enzyme involved in the formation of UDP-glucose, necessary for the synthesis of glycogen.
options.opd: It is an enzyme with branching capacity, also known as amyl (1-4) to (1-6) transglucosilasa.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Glycogenin acts as a primer of glycogen synthase -> Allows glycogen synthase to polymerize glucose molecules -> Facilitates glycogen synthesis -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Glycogenin is involved in the formation of UDP-glucose -> UDP-glucose is necessary for glycogen synthesis -> Facilitates glycogen formation -> 95%
analysis: Glycogenin acts as a primer for glycogen synthase, initiating the process of glycogen synthesis by providing the initial core for glucose molecules to be added onto.
